preprocessing: Apply RepeatedClaimMatcher.normalize(sentence) first (lowercase, NFD accent-strip, drop punctuation except '%' and ',', collapse thousands separators, collapse whitespace).

word.tokenizer: split normalized text on ' ', then build word n-grams joined by a single space

char.tokenizer: character n-grams over the whole normalized string (including spaces)

scoring: score(x) = sigmoid(intercept + dot(coef, concat(l2_normalize(tfidf_word(x)), l2_normalize(tfidf_char(x))))); tfidf(t) = (1+ln(tf)) * idf[t] for tf>0, else 0; predict Claim iff score(x) >= threshold.
